instruction.thesis: GOLD short via FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG: The primary thesis was crowded longs signaled by extreme funding (67.5% annualized at entry). Funding has collapsed from 67.5% to 19.7% annualized — a 70.8% decline — which is the core signal normalizing. Gold spot has moved favorably from 4661 to 4549 (-2.4%), approaching the 5% target. With funding now at 19.7% (well below the extreme threshold that triggered the trade) and the position at +2.42% P&L, the thesis has substantially played out. The FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG signal's stop is 2.5% and target is 5%; at 2.42% gain with funding normalized, the risk/reward of holding further is asymmetric — continued gold strength could reverse gains. Closing to lock in profit near target while thesis evidence (funding normalization) confirms the trade worked.
